module.purpose: Defines the shared shape record contract and runtime validators used to validate parent IDs, shape IDs, and complete shape records.
module.summary: This module establishes the common structural fields required by every canvas shape, including identity, positioning, hierarchy, locking, opacity, custom properties, and metadata. It pairs the generic type contract with runtime validation utilities, allowing concrete shape types to supply specialized property and metadata validators while preserving the shared record invariants.
module.businessContext: Supports the tldraw document model by ensuring shape records have valid identity, hierarchy, and serialized data. Failures can admit malformed shapes or reject otherwise valid drawing content.
classes: TLBaseShape (~L61-78): Common record contract shared by every concrete canvas shape.

module.moduleLevelCode:
import { IndexKey, JsonObject } from '@tldraw/utils'
import { T } from '@tldraw/validate'
import { idValidator } from '../misc/id-validator'
import { TLOpacityType, opacityValidator } from '../misc/TLOpacity'
import { TLParentId, TLShapeId } from '../records/TLShape'

units.name: createShapeValidator
units.source:
Type extends string,
	Props extends JsonObject,
	Meta extends JsonObject,
>(
	type: Type,
	props?: { [K in keyof Props]: T.Validatable<Props[K]> },
	meta?: { [K in keyof Meta]: T.Validatable<Meta[K]> }
) {
	return T.object<TLBaseShape<Type, Props>>({
		id: shapeIdValidator,
		typeName: T.literal('shape'),
		x: T.number,
		y: T.number,
		rotation: T.number,
		index: T.indexKey,
		parentId: parentIdValidator,
		type: T.literal(type),
		isLocked: T.boolean,
		opacity: opacityValidator,
		props: props ? T.object(props) : (T.jsonValue as any),
		meta: meta ? T.object(meta) : (T.jsonValue as any),
	})
}

detail.name: createShapeValidator
detail.signature: createShapeValidator<Type extends string, Props extends JsonObject, Meta extends JsonObject>(type: Type, props?: { [K in keyof Props]: T.Validatable<Props[K]> }, meta?: { [K in keyof Meta]: T.Validatable<Meta[K]> })
preconditions: type is a string satisfying the Type constraint.
When provided, props maps property keys to T.Validatable schemas.
When provided, meta maps property keys to T.Validatable schemas.
postconditions: Returns a T.object validator for a TLBaseShape<Type, Props>-compatible object.
The returned validator requires the fields id, typeName, x, y, rotation, index, parentId, type, isLocked, opacity, props, and meta.
The type field is validated against the literal value supplied as type.
When props is omitted, props is validated as a JSON value.
When meta is omitted, meta is validated as a JSON value.
invariants: The generated validator always uses the literal shape typeName value 'shape'.
The generated validator always uses the supplied type value as the literal validator for the type field.
The fixed base-shape fields use the corresponding predefined validators.
edgeCases: When props is undefined, the validator uses T.jsonValue rather than an object validator for props.
When meta is undefined, the validator uses T.jsonValue rather than an object validator for meta.
When props or meta is supplied as an empty schema object, the corresponding field is still validated with T.object.
An input whose type field differs from the supplied type value is rejected by the generated validator.

raises: Validation failure from the returned T.object validator for values that do not satisfy the generated schema
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: The returned validator rejects invalid input according to the validators assigned to each field.
